candidates.input_contract: shared module rows; true-patient outer splits; module-local histories
candidates.prediction_source: nested convex stack selected on disjoint patient calibration rows
candidates.fallback: persistence for every cell absent from validated_cells

candidates.input_contract: as-of aligned whole-body state; exact anchor-linked future labels; target-gated joint-JEPA only
candidates.fallback: do not invoke joint-JEPA; use the matching contract's validated source or persistence

resolution_policy.rule: Choose only candidates whose input_contract_id exactly matches the live feature schema.
forbidden: Do not blend shared-module and joint-asof predictions during validation.
Do not promote any cell absent from that candidate's validated_cells.
Do not use this catalog for treatment-effect or clinical-decision claims.
